svg.title: Scenario-adaptive wireless learning
svg.desc: Wireless tasks T1 through TK share a meta-learned initialization theta0. An adaptation operator uses a few pilots from task tau to produce adapted parameters theta tau. Conceptual method diagram, not experimental results.
svg.metadata: Conceptual research schematic; not experimental results. LaTeX labels rendered to vector paths using MathJax 3.2.2. Designed for approximately 9–10 pt labels at 3.5-inch column width.
